scope: External single-Spark EXL3 reference; no native acceptance results
profile_note: Direct Model API resident-compute profiles. Both enable pinned CPU embedding staging for completed-boundary single-token decode, as upstream Generator.decode does; prefill keeps its unpinned default. attention_eager disables only BC attention graphs; gated MLP graphs and other upstream model defaults stay enabled. Full Generator scheduling, batching, sampling and serving are not measured.

statistics.latencies: median/p95/p99 using NumPy linear quantiles; retain raw external samples
statistics.uncertainty: Seeded 2000-resample bootstrap 95% CI of median; decode token uncertainty resamples whole requests (clusters), decode acceptance uses per-request duration/64. Token p95/p99 are descriptive, not confidence-certified.
statistics.performance_noise_rule: Before native evaluation set each workload allowance to max(absolute ratio of reference block medians minus1, sum of reference median CI half-widths divided by mean reference median). Allowance above0.10 marks unstable reference and cannot pass native acceptance. Kernel samples use declared first15/last16 subblocks; corroborate beside candidate before acceptance. No arbitrary percentage floor.
statistics.native_comparison: Repeat reference beside candidate; candidate median ratio<=1+frozen allowance for every workload, with confidence intervals reported; no trading a slow case for a faster mean
statistics.memory: record current/peak torch allocated/reserved, model/cache/static accounting, CUDA mem info, host RSS/MemAvailable; compare within declared native envelopes, never sum overlapping Spark budgets

correctness.repeat_restore: Require all finite, exact bytewise equality for each fixed numerical plan; a failure remains a failure with diagnostic errors reported
correctness.cross_plan: Record max absolute/RMS/top1 changes between packed/reconstructed and optimized/attention_eager; these observations are not native tolerances
correctness.native_tolerance_gate: Exact storage and same-plan restore remain mandatory; cross-implementation bounds require independent control evidence plus held-out inputs before native acceptance; no threshold retrofitted to native discrepancy
correctness.captured_kernel: Captured/replayed outputs must be finite and exactly equal to the warmed eager result for the same plan.

state_restore: Synchronize, copy every FP16 cache tensor to CPU with position/batch shape, hash, poison live tensors, restore in place, synchronize, compare all suffix logits; no relocation/process-independent spill claim
timing: Separate all-logit correctness probes. Prefill excludes LM head; TTFT proxy includes prefix prefill plus final prompt forward and CPU argmax token availability, excluding tokenization/network. Decode wall includes CPU token availability; GPU event elapsed reported separately. Kernel timing events are captured inside one graph containing ten sequential linear invocations; each of31 samples replays the graph once and divides device elapsed by10. This removes Python dispatch gaps between invocations. Profiler symbol durations/calls are raw for ten invocations, active_device_us is their summed duration divided by10; instrumentation perturbs these diagnostic durations, which are not the parity metric. Decode is teacher-forced, not a free-running sampled trajectory. Numerical prefixes above145 check all suffix logits only.
limits: Finite synthetic input trajectories are not model quality evaluation
CPU MoE/offload and CPU collectives disabled explicitly by ARM build patch
No native VMM, pending cancellation, cross-process state restore or paging performance validated
No speculative decoding or multi-sequence batching
